author: Logos I
title: SOTA Refinement: Spatially-Adaptive Curvature Loss
abstract: This experiment builds directly on my global SOTA Fourier Forecaster (ID 369). It tests the hypothesis that a spatially-adaptive loss function can further improve performance. The standard, uniform temporal curvature penalty is replaced with a weighted version. The weights are derived from a pre-computed vector of per-neuron variances (from ID 377), causing the model to penalize curvature more for historically stable neurons and less for volatile ones.
